title: Assign a text template to a sheet position
description: Let a user assign one saved text template to a selected label position in stable sheet order and recover that exact relationship after reload.
acceptanceCriteria: Positions have stable identifiers derived from row-major sheet order
The UI exposes a semantic keyboard-operable position selector
Assigning a template stores exact template identity and position identity on the project
Out-of-range, duplicate, missing-template, or stale-position assignments are refused with actionable reasons
The same template-position relationship is visible after browser reload

steps.details: Derive row-major position IDs from the exact layout revision and expose row, column, ordinal, and physical boundary metadata without using array index as durable identity alone.
Add serializable project assignments linking exact position ID to exact template ID, with validation against the resolved project revision and template repository.
Render positions as a labeled list, grid with keyboard alternative, or native selection control that communicates ordinal, row, column, and assigned template.
Save assignment add/change/remove operations atomically with the project draft and display success or refusal without losing current selection.
Assign a text template using keyboard controls, reload the browser, and assert the same template and stable position are selected and described.

technicalNotes: Stable sheet order is row-major unless the domain contract documents another order.
Changing the referenced layout revision requires explicit assignment compatibility handling.
